questions.text: बिन्दुओं (1, 3) और (1, –3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिन्दु स्थित है :
questions.text_english: The mid-point of the line segment joining points (1, 3) and (1, –3) lies :
questions.solution: The mid-point of (1, 3) and (1, –3) is calculated using the mid-point formula: x = (1+1)/2 = 1, y = (3+(–3))/2 = 0. So the mid-point is (1, 0). Since the y-coordinate is 0 and x-coordinate is 1 (non-zero), the point lies on the x-axis. Therefore, option (C) 'on x-axis' is correct. Option (D) y-axis would require x = 0, which is not the case here. Option (A) origin requires both coordinates to be zero. Option (B) second quadrant requires x < 0.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, यदि DE || BC, AD = 1·5 cm, DB = 3 cm और EC = 2 cm है, तो AC की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, if DE || BC, AD = 1·5 cm, DB = 3 cm and EC = 2 cm, the length of AC is :
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with D on AB and E on AC such that DE is parallel to BC. AD = 1.5 cm, DB = 3 cm, EC = 2 cm.
questions.solution: By the Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales' Theorem), since DE || BC, we have AD/DB = AE/EC. So AE/EC = 1.5/3 = 1/2, which gives AE = EC/2 = 2/2 = 1 cm. Therefore, AC = AE + EC = 1 + 2 = 3 cm. The correct answer is (B) 3 cm. Option (D) 4.5 cm is incorrect as it results from adding without applying the ratio. Options (A) and (C) do not satisfy the BPT ratio condition.
questions.solution_hindi: आधारभूत समानुपात प्रमेय (BPT) से, AD/DB = AE/EC ⟹ 1.5/3 = AE/2 ⟹ AE = 1 cm। अतः AC = AE + EC = 1 + 2 = 3 cm।

questions.text: दो संकेंद्रित वृत्तों में, छोटे वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा बड़े वृत्त को काटती है :
questions.text_english: In two concentric circles, a tangent to the smaller circle will intersect the larger circle at :
questions.solution: A tangent to the smaller circle touches it at exactly one point and is a straight line. Since the larger circle has a greater radius and the tangent line lies inside the larger circle (as it touches only the smaller circle), it will extend and intersect the larger circle at two distinct points. Therefore, the correct answer is (C) two points. It cannot be zero or one point since the line must cross the boundary of the larger circle at entry and exit.
questions.solution_hindi: छोटे वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा एक सीधी रेखा होती है जो बड़े वृत्त के अंदर से गुज़रती है, इसलिए यह बड़े वृत्त को दो बिन्दुओं पर काटती है।

questions.text: 2 tan 60° / (1 – tan² 60°) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of 2 tan 60° / (1 – tan² 60°) is :
questions.solution: We know that tan 60° = √3. So, 2 tan 60° / (1 – tan² 60°) = 2√3 / (1 – (√3)²) = 2√3 / (1 – 3) = 2√3 / (–2) = –√3. This expression is actually the double angle formula for tan, i.e., tan 2θ = 2tanθ/(1–tan²θ), so here it equals tan 120° = –√3. The correct answer is (D) –√3.

questions.text: (sin θ + cos θ)² + (sin θ – cos θ)² =
questions.text_english: (sin θ + cos θ)² + (sin θ – cos θ)² =
questions.solution: Expanding: (sin θ + cos θ)² = sin²θ + 2 sin θ cos θ + cos²θ = 1 + 2 sin θ cos θ. And (sin θ – cos θ)² = sin²θ – 2 sin θ cos θ + cos²θ = 1 – 2 sin θ cos θ. Adding both: (1 + 2 sin θ cos θ) + (1 – 2 sin θ cos θ) = 2. The 2 sin θ cos θ terms cancel each other, giving the final answer as (B) 2.
questions.solution_hindi: विस्तार करने पर: (sinθ+cosθ)² + (sinθ–cosθ)² = (1+2sinθcosθ) + (1–2sinθcosθ) = 2।

questions.text: जब सूर्य का उन्नयन 30° से 60° में बदलता है तो एक मीनार की छाया की लम्बाई :
questions.text_english: The length of the shadow of a tower when the sun's altitude changes from 30° to 60° will :
questions.solution: Let the height of the tower be h. When angle of elevation is 30°, shadow length = h/tan30° = h√3. When angle of elevation is 60°, shadow length = h/tan60° = h/√3. Since h/√3 < h√3, the shadow becomes shorter as the sun's altitude increases from 30° to 60°. The correct answer is (A) become shorter.
questions.solution_hindi: जब उन्नयन कोण 30° हो: छाया = h√3, और 60° हो: छाया = h/√3। चूँकि h/√3 < h√3, छाया छोटी हो जाएगी।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, छायांकित भाग निरूपित करता है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, the shaded region represents :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. The shaded region is the smaller area between a chord and the minor arc (below the chord), which is the minor segment.
questions.solution: A segment of a circle is the region between a chord and the arc it cuts off. The minor segment is the smaller of the two regions formed by a chord, and it lies on the side of the minor arc. The shaded region in the figure is bounded by the chord and the minor arc (the smaller arc), and it does not include the centre O. This is by definition the minor segment. Therefore, option (C) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: जीवा और लघु चाप के बीच का क्षेत्रफल लघु वृत्तखंड (minor segment) कहलाता है। चित्र में छायांकित भाग यही है।
questions.topic: Sector and Segment of a Circle

questions.text: त्रिज्या '2r' के वृत्त के एक चतुर्थांश का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of a quadrant of a circle of radius '2r' is :
questions.solution: The area of a full circle of radius 2r is π(2r)² = 4πr². A quadrant is one-fourth of a circle, so its area = (1/4) × 4πr² = πr². The correct answer is (C) πr². Option (A) gives (1/4)πr² which corresponds to a quadrant of a circle of radius r (not 2r). Option (D) 2πr² is incorrect as it does not follow from any standard formula here.
questions.solution_hindi: त्रिज्या 2r के वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल = π(2r)² = 4πr²। चतुर्थांश = (1/4) × 4πr² = πr²।

questions.text: ऊँचाई 'h' और त्रिज्या 'r' का एक शंकु समान आयाम के एक ठोस बेलन पर अध्यारोपित है। पूरे ठोस का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल होगा :
questions.text_english: A cone of height 'h' and radius 'r' is surmounted on a solid cylinder of same dimensions. The total surface area of the entire solid will be :
questions.solution: The total surface area of the combined solid consists of: (1) Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh, (2) Bottom circular base of the cylinder = πr², (3) Curved surface area of cone = πrl where l = √(h²+r²). The top circular face of the cylinder is covered by the base of the cone, so it is not included. Total = 2πrh + πr² + πr√(h²+r²). The correct answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ (2πrh) + बेलन का निचला आधार (πr²) + शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठ (πrl) = 2πrh + πr² + πr√(h²+r²)।

questions.text: बहुलक के सूत्र बहुलक = l + [(f₁ – f₀)/(2f₁ – f₀ – f₂)] × h में f₁ दर्शाता है :
questions.text_english: In the formula of mode given by mode = l + [(f₁ – f₀)/(2f₁ – f₀ – f₂)] × h, f₁ denotes the :

options.B: बहुलक वर्ग से ठीक पहले वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता
options.C: बहुलक वर्ग के ठीक बाद में आने वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता

options_english.B: frequency of class preceding modal class
options_english.C: frequency of class succeeding modal class

questions.solution: In the mode formula, l is the lower boundary of the modal class, h is the class width, f₁ is the frequency of the modal class (the class with the highest frequency), f₀ is the frequency of the class preceding the modal class, and f₂ is the frequency of the class succeeding the modal class. Therefore, f₁ denotes the frequency of the modal class, and the correct answer is (A).
questions.solution_hindi: बहुलक के सूत्र में f₁ बहुलक वर्ग की बारंबारता दर्शाता है, f₀ पूर्ववर्ती वर्ग की और f₂ परवर्ती वर्ग की बारंबारता है।

questions.text: किसी बंटन के लिए, यदि माध्य = माध्यक = a है, तो इस बंटन का बहुलक है :
questions.text_english: For a distribution, if mean = median = a, then its mode is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship: Mode = 3 × Median – 2 × Mean. Given mean = median = a, Mode = 3a – 2a = a. So when mean and median are equal, the mode is also equal to the same value a. This means the distribution is symmetric, and all three measures of central tendency coincide. The correct answer is (C) a.
questions.solution_hindi: सूत्र: बहुलक = 3 × माध्यक – 2 × माध्य = 3a – 2a = a। अतः बहुलक = a।
questions.topic: Relationship between Mean, Median and Mode

questions.text: तीन पासों को एक साथ फेंकने पर संभव परिणामों की कुल संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The total number of outcomes in the experiment of simultaneous throw of three dice is :
questions.solution: Each die has 6 faces showing numbers 1 to 6. When three dice are thrown simultaneously, the total number of outcomes is obtained by multiplying the number of outcomes of each die: 6 × 6 × 6 = 216. Option (C) 36 is for two dice, and option (A) 6 is for one die. Therefore, the correct answer is (D) 216.
questions.solution_hindi: प्रत्येक पासे के 6 परिणाम होते हैं। तीन पासे एक साथ फेंकने पर कुल परिणाम = 6 × 6 × 6 = 216।

questions.text: दो संख्याओं 3 और 5 के लिए, (HCF – LCM) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of (HCF – LCM) for the two numbers 3 and 5 is :
questions.solution: Since 3 and 5 are both prime numbers, their HCF = 1 and their LCM = 3 × 5 = 15. Therefore, HCF – LCM = 1 – 15 = –14. The correct answer is (D) –14. Option (C) 14 is incorrect because the question asks for HCF minus LCM, not LCM minus HCF.
questions.solution_hindi: 3 और 5 अभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं, इसलिए HCF = 1 और LCM = 15। HCF – LCM = 1 – 15 = –14।

questions.text: किसी प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए, संख्या 3ⁿ कभी भी समाप्त नहीं होती है अंक :
questions.text_english: The number 3ⁿ, where n is a natural number cannot end with the digit :
questions.solution: The powers of 3 follow a cycle of unit digits: 3¹ = 3, 3² = 9, 3³ = 27 (ends in 7), 3⁴ = 81 (ends in 1), 3⁵ = 243 (ends in 3), and the pattern {3, 9, 7, 1} repeats. The digit 5 never appears as the last digit of any power of 3, because for a number to end in 5, it must be divisible by 5, and 3ⁿ is never divisible by 5. The correct answer is (C) 5.
questions.solution_hindi: 3 की घातों के इकाई अंक 3, 9, 7, 1 के क्रम में दोहराते हैं। 5 कभी नहीं आता, क्योंकि 3ⁿ कभी 5 से विभाज्य नहीं होता।

questions.text: समीकरण निकाय x = 3, y = –1 के हलों की संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The number of solutions of the system of equations x = 3, y = –1 is :
questions.solution: The system x = 3 and y = –1 represents two straight lines parallel to the y-axis and x-axis respectively. They intersect at exactly one point, which is (3, –1). A system of two linear equations in two variables that are consistent and independent has exactly one solution. Therefore, the correct answer is (B) 1.
questions.solution_hindi: x = 3 एक ऊर्ध्वाधर रेखा है और y = –1 एक क्षैतिज रेखा है। ये दोनों रेखाएँ बिन्दु (3, –1) पर एक-दूसरे को काटती हैं, अतः एकमात्र हल है।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: समीकरण x² + 3x + a = 0 के मूल वास्तविक और बराबर रखने के लिए, 'a' का मान होता है :
questions.text_english: The value of 'a' for which the equation x² + 3x + a = 0 has real and equal roots is :
questions.solution: For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 to have real and equal roots, the discriminant must be zero: D = b² – 4ac = 0. Here, a = 1, b = 3, c = a (unknown). So 3² – 4(1)(a) = 0 ⟹ 9 – 4a = 0 ⟹ a = 9/4. The correct answer is (B) 9/4.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित समीकरणों में से कौन-सा द्विघात समीकरण है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following equations is a quadratic equation ?
questions.solution: Option (A): x² = (x+1)² ⟹ x² = x²+2x+1 ⟹ 2x+1=0, which is linear, not quadratic. Option (B): (x–1)(x+2) = 2x+1 ⟹ x²+x–2 = 2x+1 ⟹ x²–x–3 = 0, which is a quadratic equation (degree 2). Option (C): (x+2)³ = 2x(x²–1) ⟹ x³+... = 2x³–2x, which simplifies to a cubic or higher. Option (D): √x = x² is not in standard polynomial form. Therefore, the correct answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प (B): (x–1)(x+2) = 2x+1 ⟹ x²–x–3 = 0, जो एक द्विघात समीकरण है। शेष विकल्प रैखिक या उच्च कोटि के हैं।

questions.text: मूल-बिन्दु से बिन्दु (2, 3) की दूरी है :
questions.text_english: The distance of the point (2, 3) from the origin is :
questions.solution: Using the distance formula, distance from origin (0, 0) to (2, 3) = √[(2–0)² + (3–0)²] = √[4 + 9] = √13. The correct answer is (D) √13. Options (A) and (B) are just the individual coordinates, not the distance. Option (C) 5 would be the distance if the point were (3, 4) or (4, 3).

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : सभी सर्वांगसम त्रिभुज, समरूप त्रिभुज होते हैं।
तर्क (R) : सर्वांगसम त्रिभुजों में, संगत भुजाओं का अनुपात 1 : 1 होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): All congruent triangles are similar.
Reason (R): In congruent triangles, the ratio of corresponding sides is 1 : 1.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: congruent triangles have the same shape and size, and since similar triangles only require the same shape (equal angles and proportional sides), all congruent triangles are indeed similar. Reason (R) is also true: in congruent triangles, corresponding sides are equal, so their ratio is 1:1, which is a constant (making them similar). Furthermore, R correctly explains A because the 1:1 ratio of sides satisfies the similarity condition. Therefore, the correct answer is (A).
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सत्य हैं। सर्वांगसम त्रिभुजों में संगत भुजाओं का अनुपात 1:1 होता है, जो समरूपता की शर्त को पूरा करता है, इसलिए तर्क (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : 36 को विभाजित करने वाली अभाज्य संख्याएँ 6 को भी विभाजित करती हैं।
तर्क (R) : कोई संख्या यदि p² को विभाजित करती है, तो वह p को भी विभाजित करती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The prime numbers which divide 36 also divide 6.
Reason (R): Any number which divides p² also divides p.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): 36 = 2² × 3². The prime factors of 36 are 2 and 3. Since 6 = 2 × 3, both primes 2 and 3 also divide 6. So Assertion (A) is TRUE. Reason (R): 'Any number which divides p² also divides p' is FALSE in general. For example, 4 divides 4² = 16, but 4 does not divide 4 (wait — actually 4 divides itself). A correct counterexample: 4 divides 4², but 4 is not prime. However, the statement is true only for prime numbers (by Euclid's lemma). Since the Reason states it for 'any number' (not just primes), R is false. Therefore, the correct answer is (C): A is true, R is false.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A): 36 के अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2 और 3 हैं, जो 6 को भी विभाजित करते हैं — सत्य है। तर्क (R): 'कोई भी संख्या जो p² को विभाजित करती है, वह p को भी विभाजित करती है' — यह केवल अभाज्य संख्याओं के लिए सत्य है, सभी संख्याओं के लिए नहीं, इसलिए R असत्य है।

questions.text: एक वृत्त के परिगत एक चतुर्भुज बना है, जैसा दी गई आकृति में दिखाया गया है। यदि AB = 5 cm, BC = 7 cm तथा CD = 6 cm है, तो AD की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A quadrilateral circumscribes the circle as shown in the given figure. If AB = 5 cm, BC = 7 cm and CD = 6 cm, then find the length of AD.
questions.image_description: A circle inscribed in quadrilateral ABCD. The quadrilateral has vertices A (top), B (bottom-left), C (bottom-right), and D (top-right). AB = 5 cm, BC = 7 cm, CD = 6 cm.
questions.solution: By the property of tangents drawn from an external point to a circle, the two tangent segments from any external point are equal in length. If we let the tangent lengths from each vertex be: from A = p, from B = q, from C = s, from D = t, then AB = p + q = 5, BC = q + s = 7, CD = s + t = 6, and AD = p + t. Using the property: AB + CD = BC + AD, we get 5 + 6 = 7 + AD, so AD = 11 – 7 = 4 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: वृत्त के परिगत चतुर्भुज के लिए: AB + CD = BC + AD। अतः 5 + 6 = 7 + AD ⟹ AD = 4 cm।

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : sin 45° / (sec 30° – tan 30°)
questions.text_english: Evaluate : sin 45° / (sec 30° – tan 30°)

questions.text:
(क) एक बड़े वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड, जिसका केंद्रीय कोण 120° है, का क्षेत्रफल एक छोटे वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है। छोटे वृत्त और बड़े वृत्त की त्रिज्याएँ क्रमश: 'r' और 'R' हैं। r : R ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) दी गई आकृति में, त्रिज्या 7 cm के वृत्त का केन्द्र O है। AB, वृत्त की एक जीवा है। छायांकित भाग का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) The area of a smaller circle is equal to the area of a sector of a larger circle with central angle 120°. The radii of the smaller and larger circles are 'r' and 'R' respectively. Find r : R.
OR
(b) In the given figure, O is the centre of a circle of radius 7 cm. AB is a chord of the circle. Find the perimeter of the shaded region.
questions.image_description: For part (b): A circle with centre O and radius 7 cm. A chord AB is drawn such that the central angle AOB = 60°. The shaded region is the minor segment (between chord AB and minor arc AB).
questions.solution:
Part (a): Area of smaller circle = πr². Area of sector of larger circle with central angle 120° = (120/360)πR² = πR²/3. Setting them equal: πr² = πR²/3, so r² = R²/3, giving r/R = 1/√3. Therefore r : R = 1 : √3.

Part (b): The central angle AOB = 60°. Since OA = OB = 7 cm (radii), triangle AOB is equilateral (as all angles are 60°), so AB = 7 cm. Arc length = (60/360) × 2π × 7 = 7π/3 cm. Perimeter of shaded region = arc AB + chord AB = 7π/3 + 7 cm.
questions.solution_hindi:
(क): πr² = (120/360)πR² ⟹ r² = R²/3 ⟹ r:R = 1:√3।
(ख): केंद्रीय कोण = 60°, r = 7 cm। चाप की लंबाई = 7π/3 cm, जीवा AB = 7 cm (समबाहु त्रिभुज)। परिमाप = 7π/3 + 7 cm।
questions.topic: Area of Sectors and Perimeter of Segments

questions.text:
(क) c का मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म के अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं :
cx + 3y = c – 3
12x + cy = c
अथवा
(ख) x और y के लिए हल कीजिए :
3x + 2y = 65
2x + 3y = 60
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the value of c for which the following pair of linear equations has infinitely many solutions :
cx + 3y = c – 3
12x + cy = c
OR
(b) Solve for x and y :
3x + 2y = 65
2x + 3y = 60
questions.solution:
Part (a): For infinitely many solutions, the ratios of coefficients must be equal: c/12 = 3/c = (c–3)/c. From c/12 = 3/c, we get c² = 36, so c = ±6. Checking c = 6: 3/c = 3/6 = 1/2 and (c–3)/c = 3/6 = 1/2. All ratios equal, so c = 6. (c = –6 gives 3/c = –1/2 but c/12 = –1/2, check (c–3)/c = –9/–6 = 3/2 ≠ –1/2, so rejected.) Therefore c = 6.

Part (b): Adding both equations: 5x + 5y = 125 ⟹ x + y = 25. Subtracting second from first: x – y = 5. Solving: 2x = 30 ⟹ x = 15, y = 10. Wait — let me redo: 3x+2y=65 and 2x+3y=60. Multiply first by 3 and second by 2: 9x+6y=195 and 4x+6y=120. Subtracting: 5x = 75 ⟹ x = 15. Then 3(15)+2y=65 ⟹ 2y=20 ⟹ y=10. So x = 15, y = 10.
questions.solution_hindi:
(क): अनन्त हलों के लिए c/12 = 3/c ⟹ c² = 36 ⟹ c = 6।
(ख): 3x+2y=65 और 2x+3y=60 को हल करने पर x = 15, y = 10।
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Consistency and Solution of Linear Equations

questions.text: त्रिभुज ABC की भुजा BC पर एक बिन्दु D इस प्रकार स्थित है कि ∠ADC = ∠BAC. सिद्ध कीजिए कि (CA)² = CB · CD.
questions.text_english: D is a point on side BC of △ABC such that ∠ADC = ∠BAC. Prove that (CA)² = CB · CD.

key_points: In triangles BAC and ADC, ∠BAC = ∠ADC (given) and ∠ACB = ∠ACD (common angle). By AA similarity, △BAC ~ △ADC. Therefore BC/AC = AC/DC, which gives AC² = BC · DC, i.e., (CA)² = CB · CD.

questions.solution: In △BAC and △ADC: ∠BAC = ∠ADC (given). ∠BCA = ∠ACD (common angle, as C is the same vertex). By AA similarity criterion, △BAC ~ △ADC. Therefore, the corresponding sides are proportional: CB/CA = CA/CD. Cross-multiplying, we get CA × CA = CB × CD, which gives (CA)² = CB · CD. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: △BAC और △ADC में: ∠BAC = ∠ADC (दिया है) और ∠BCA = ∠ACD (उभयनिष्ठ कोण)। AA कसौटी से △BAC ~ △ADC। अतः CB/CA = CA/CD ⟹ (CA)² = CB · CD। इति सिद्धम्।

questions.text:
(क) निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म को ग्राफ़ द्वारा हल कीजिए :
2x – y = 2 और 4x – y = 4
इन समीकरणों से निरूपित रेखाएँ, y-अक्ष को जिन बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेदित करती हैं, उन बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक भी लिखिए।
अथवा
(ख) क्रिकेट कोचिंग प्रदान करने वाली एक अकादमी ने 10 बल्ले और 5 गेंदें, ₹ 32,500 में खरीदे। बाद में, अकादमी ने 2 बल्ले और 8 गेंदें, ₹ 10,000 में खरीदे। यदि बल्ले और गेंद की कीमत में कोई बदलाव नहीं हुआ हो, तो 1 बल्ले और 1 गेंद की कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Solve graphically the following pair of linear equations : 2x – y = 2 and 4x – y = 4. Also, write the coordinates of the points where the lines represented by these equations cut the y-axis.
OR
(b) An academy offering cricket coaching bought 10 bats and 5 balls for ₹32,500. Later, the academy bought 2 bats and 8 balls for ₹10,000. If there is no change in the cost of the bat and of the ball, find the cost of 1 bat and 1 ball.

key_points: (a) Solution: x = 1, y = 0; Line 1 cuts y-axis at (0, –2); Line 2 cuts y-axis at (0, –4)
(b) Cost of 1 bat = ₹3,000; Cost of 1 ball = ₹500

questions.solution:
Part (a): For 2x – y = 2: when x=0, y=–2; when y=0, x=1. For 4x – y = 4: when x=0, y=–4; when y=0, x=1. Both lines pass through (1, 0). Plotting and extending shows they intersect at (1, 0). Line 1 cuts the y-axis at (0, –2) and Line 2 cuts the y-axis at (0, –4).

Part (b): Let cost of 1 bat = ₹x and 1 ball = ₹y. Then 10x + 5y = 32500 ... (i) and 2x + 8y = 10000 ... (ii). From (i): 2x + y = 6500. From (ii): x + 4y = 5000. Multiply first by 4: 8x + 4y = 26000. Subtract second: 7x = 21000 ⟹ x = 3000. Then y = 6500 – 2(3000) = 500. Cost of 1 bat = ₹3,000 and 1 ball = ₹500.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
questions.topic: Graphical and Algebraic Methods of Solution

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, TP और TQ, वृत्त के बिन्दुओं P और Q पर क्रमश: स्पर्श-रेखाएँ हैं। यदि प्रतिवर्ती ∠POQ = 250° है, तो चतुर्भुज POQT के प्रत्येक कोण की माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, TP and TQ are tangents at points P and Q of the circle respectively. If reflex ∠POQ = 250°, find the measure of each angle of quadrilateral POQT.
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O. External point T from which two tangents TP and TQ are drawn to points P and Q on the circle. The reflex angle POQ = 250°.
questions.solution: Reflex ∠POQ = 250°, so ∠POQ (non-reflex) = 360° – 250° = 110°. Since TP and TQ are tangents from external point T to the circle at P and Q respectively, OP ⊥ TP and OQ ⊥ TQ. Therefore ∠OPT = 90° and ∠OQT = 90°. In quadrilateral POQT, the sum of all angles = 360°. So ∠PTQ = 360° – ∠POQ – ∠OPT – ∠OQT = 360° – 110° – 90° – 90° = 70°. The four angles of quadrilateral POQT are: ∠POQ = 110°, ∠OPT = 90°, ∠OQT = 90°, and ∠PTQ = 70°.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिका को सिद्ध कीजिए :
(1 – sin θ)/cos θ + cos θ/(1 – sin θ) = 2 sec θ
questions.text_english:
Prove the following trigonometric identity :
(1 – sin θ)/cos θ + cos θ/(1 – sin θ) = 2 sec θ

key_points: LHS = [(1–sinθ)² + cos²θ] / [cosθ(1–sinθ)] = [1 – 2sinθ + sin²θ + cos²θ] / [cosθ(1–sinθ)] = [2 – 2sinθ] / [cosθ(1–sinθ)] = 2(1–sinθ)/[cosθ(1–sinθ)] = 2/cosθ = 2 secθ = RHS

questions.solution: LHS = (1 – sin θ)/cos θ + cos θ/(1 – sin θ). Taking LCM as cos θ(1 – sin θ): LHS = [(1 – sin θ)² + cos²θ] / [cos θ(1 – sin θ)]. Expanding the numerator: (1 – sin θ)² + cos²θ = 1 – 2sin θ + sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 – 2sin θ + 1 = 2 – 2sin θ = 2(1 – sin θ). So LHS = 2(1 – sin θ) / [cos θ(1 – sin θ)] = 2/cos θ = 2 sec θ = RHS. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: LHS = [(1–sinθ)² + cos²θ] / [cosθ(1–sinθ)] = [2–2sinθ] / [cosθ(1–sinθ)] = 2/cosθ = 2 secθ = RHS। इति सिद्धम्।

questions.text:
संयोग (chance) के एक खेल में, एक पहिये को घुमाया जाता है, जो विश्राम में आने के बाद संख्याओं 1, 2, 3, ..., 10 (दी गई आकृति में दिखाए अनुसार) में से किसी एक संख्या को इंगित करता है। यदि सभी परिणाम समप्रायिक हैं, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह पहिया :
(i) 2 से बड़ी अभाज्य संख्या को इंगित करेगा ?
(ii) 9 से छोटी विषम संख्या को इंगित करेगा ?
(iii) 4 के गुणज को इंगित करेगा ?
questions.text_english:
A game of chance consists of spinning a wheel which comes to rest at one of the numbers from 1 to 10 (as shown in the given figure) with equal probabilities. What is the probability that the wheel stops at :
(i) a prime number greater than 2 ?
(ii) an odd number less than 9 ?
(iii) a multiple of 4 ?
questions.image_description: A spinning wheel divided into 10 equal sectors numbered 1 to 10.
questions.solution: Total outcomes = 10. (i) Prime numbers greater than 2 from 1–10: {3, 5, 7} — 3 numbers. But 2 is excluded, so primes > 2 are 3, 5, 7. Wait — also check: primes in 1–10 are 2, 3, 5, 7. Primes greater than 2: {3, 5, 7} = 3 numbers. P = 3/10. Actually checking: {3, 5, 7} gives 3 favourable outcomes. P(i) = 3/10. (ii) Odd numbers less than 9: {1, 3, 5, 7} = 4 numbers. P(ii) = 4/10 = 2/5. (iii) Multiples of 4 from 1–10: {4, 8} = 2 numbers. P(iii) = 2/10 = 1/5.

questions.text:
(क) सिद्ध कीजिए कि √5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
अथवा
(ख) अंकगणित का आधारभूत प्रमेय लिखिए और इसके प्रयोग से, 36 और 54 का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Prove that √5 is an irrational number.
OR
(b) State the 'Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic' and use it to find LCM of 36 and 54.

key_points: (a) Proof by contradiction: assume √5 = p/q, then 5 divides p, then 5 divides q — contradiction

questions.solution:
Part (a): Assume √5 is rational. Then √5 = p/q where p and q are co-prime integers with q ≠ 0. Squaring: 5 = p²/q², so p² = 5q². This means 5 divides p², and since 5 is prime, 5 divides p. Let p = 5m. Then 25m² = 5q², so q² = 5m², meaning 5 divides q². Since 5 is prime, 5 divides q. But this contradicts our assumption that p and q are co-prime. Therefore, √5 is irrational.

Part (b): The Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic states that every composite number can be expressed uniquely as a product of prime numbers. 36 = 2² × 3² and 54 = 2 × 3³. LCM = 2² × 3³ = 4 × 27 = 108.
questions.solution_hindi:
(क): मान लीजिए √5 = p/q (p और q सह-अभाज्य)। तो p² = 5q² ⟹ 5|p ⟹ p = 5m ⟹ 5|q, जो विरोधाभास है। अतः √5 अपरिमेय है।
(ख): 36 = 2²×3² और 54 = 2×3³। LCM = 2²×3³ = 108।
questions.topic: Irrational Numbers and Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic

questions.text: बहुपद p(x) = 2x² + 5x + 2 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए और p(x) के शून्यकों तथा इसके गुणांकों के बीच संबंध की सत्यता की जाँच कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = 2x² + 5x + 2 and verify the relationship between zeroes of p(x) and its coefficients.
questions.solution: p(x) = 2x² + 5x + 2. Factorising: 2x² + 4x + x + 2 = 2x(x + 2) + 1(x + 2) = (2x + 1)(x + 2). So the zeroes are x = –1/2 and x = –2. Verification: Sum of zeroes = –1/2 + (–2) = –5/2 = –b/a = –5/2 ✓. Product of zeroes = (–1/2)(–2) = 1 = c/a = 2/2 = 1 ✓. The relationship between zeroes and coefficients is verified.

questions.text:
दो त्रिभुजों की समरूपता की AA कसौटी बताइए और इसका उपयोग निम्नलिखित को सिद्ध करने के लिए कीजिए।
दी गई आकृतियों में △ABC और △PQR में, AD और PS क्रमश: ∠BAC और ∠RPQ के समद्विभाजक हैं।
यदि △ABC ~ △PQR है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि △ACD ~ △PRS.
questions.text_english:
State AA criterion of similarity of two triangles and use it to prove the following.
In the given figures of △ABC and △PQR, AD and PS are angle bisectors of ∠BAC and ∠RPQ respectively.
If △ABC ~ △PQR, prove that △ACD ~ △PRS.

key_points: AA criterion: If two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of another, the triangles are similar

questions.image_description: Two triangles: Triangle ABC with D on BC (AD is angle bisector of angle BAC), and Triangle PQR with S on RQ (PS is angle bisector of angle RPQ).
questions.solution:
AA Criterion: If two angles of one triangle are respectively equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar.

Proof: Given △ABC ~ △PQR. Therefore ∠BAC = ∠RPQ (corresponding angles of similar triangles) and ∠ACB = ∠PRS (since ∠ACB = ∠PRQ and D is on BC, S is on RQ).

Since AD bisects ∠BAC: ∠CAD = ∠BAC/2. Since PS bisects ∠RPQ: ∠RPS = ∠RPQ/2. Since ∠BAC = ∠RPQ, we have ∠CAD = ∠RPS.

In △ACD and △PRS: ∠CAD = ∠RPS (proved above) and ∠ACD = ∠PRS (corresponding angles of similar triangles △ABC ~ △PQR).

By AA criterion, △ACD ~ △PRS. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi:
AA कसौटी: यदि एक त्रिभुज के दो कोण दूसरे त्रिभुज के दो कोणों के बराबर हों, तो दोनों त्रिभुज समरूप होते हैं।

△ABC ~ △PQR ⟹ ∠BAC = ∠RPQ और ∠ACB = ∠PRS। AD, ∠BAC का समद्विभाजक है, इसलिए ∠CAD = ∠BAC/2। PS, ∠RPQ का समद्विभाजक है, इसलिए ∠RPS = ∠RPQ/2। अतः ∠CAD = ∠RPS।

△ACD और △PRS में: ∠CAD = ∠RPS और ∠ACD = ∠PRS। AA कसौटी से △ACD ~ △PRS। इति सिद्धम्।

questions.text: लकड़ी के 14 cm भुजा वाले एक घनाकार ब्लॉक की ऊपरी सतह से एक अर्धगोला खोदकर निकाला जाता है। यदि अर्धगोले का व्यास घनाकार ब्लॉक की एक भुजा की लम्बाई के बराबर है, तो बचे हुए ठोस का संपूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 22/7 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: A hemispherical depression is scooped out from the top face of a wooden cubical block of side 14 cm. If the diameter of the hemisphere is equal to the side of the cube, find the total surface area of the remaining solid block. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution: Side of cube = 14 cm. Diameter of hemisphere = 14 cm, so radius r = 7 cm. Total surface area of remaining solid = Surface area of cube – Area of circular base of hemisphere (which is scooped out from top face) + Curved surface area of hemisphere. Surface area of cube = 6 × (14)² = 6 × 196 = 1176 cm². Area of circular top cut = π × 7² = 22/7 × 49 = 154 cm². Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2πr² = 2 × 22/7 × 49 = 308 cm². Total surface area = 1176 – 154 + 308 = 1330 cm².
questions.solution_hindi: घन की भुजा = 14 cm, अर्धगोले की त्रिज्या = 7 cm। कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल = घन का पूर्ण क्षेत्रफल – वृत्ताकार आधार + अर्धगोले का वक्र पृष्ठ = 1176 – 154 + 308 = 1330 cm²।
questions.topic: Surface Area of Combination of Solids

questions.text:
(क) एक पौधे की 40 पत्तियों की लम्बाइयाँ निकटतम मिलीमीटर में मापी जाती हैं तथा प्राप्त आँकड़ों को निम्नलिखित सारणी के रूप में निरूपित किया जाता है :
लम्बाई (mm में) | पत्तियों की संख्या
100–120 | 8
120–140 | 9
140–160 | 12
160–180 | 5
180–200 | 6
पत्तियों की माध्यक लम्बाई (mm में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) एक कक्षा अध्यापक ने अपनी कक्षा के 30 विद्यार्थियों की अनुपस्थिति निम्नलिखित रूप में रिकॉर्ड (Record) की :
दिनों की संख्या | 0–4 | 4–8 | 8–12 | 12–16 | 16–20 | 20–24
अनुपस्थित विद्यार्थियों की संख्या | 1 | 8 | x | 6 | 5 | y
यदि एक विद्यार्थी की अनुपस्थिति की माध्य संख्या 12 है, तो x और y के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) The lengths of 40 leaves of a plant are measured, correct to the nearest millimetre and data obtained is represented in the following table :
Length in (mm) | Number of leaves
100–120 | 8
120–140 | 9
140–160 | 12
160–180 | 5
180–200 | 6
Find the median length (in mm) of the leaves.
OR
(b) A class teacher has the following absentees record of 30 students of a class.
Number of days | 0–4 | 4–8 | 8–12 | 12–16 | 16–20 | 20–24
Number of Absent students | 1 | 8 | x | 6 | 5 | y
If the mean number of days a student was absent is 12, find the values of x and y.
questions.topic: Median and Mean of Grouped Data

questions.text:
(क) दो वर्गों के क्षेत्रफलों का योगफल 2650 cm² है। यदि उनके परिमापों का योगफल 280 cm है, तो दिए गए दो वर्गों की भुजाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) समीकरण 1/x – 1/(x–2) = 3, (x ≠ 0, 2) को एक द्विघात समीकरण के मानक रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए। अत:, इस प्रकार प्राप्त हुए द्विघात समीकरण के मूल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) The sum of areas of two squares is 2650 cm². If the sum of their perimeters is 280 cm, find the sides of the two given squares.
OR
(b) Express the equation 1/x – 1/(x–2) = 3, (x ≠ 0, 2) as a quadratic equation in standard form. Hence, find the roots of the quadratic equation so obtained.
questions.solution:
Part (a): Let the sides be a and b. Then a² + b² = 2650 and 4a + 4b = 280 ⟹ a + b = 70. So b = 70 – a. Substituting: a² + (70–a)² = 2650 ⟹ a² + 4900 – 140a + a² = 2650 ⟹ 2a² – 140a + 2250 = 0 ⟹ a² – 70a + 1125 = 0 ⟹ (a–45)(a–25) = 0. So a = 45 or a = 25. The sides are 45 cm and 25 cm.

Part (b): 1/x – 1/(x–2) = 3 ⟹ (x–2–x)/[x(x–2)] = 3 ⟹ –2 = 3x(x–2) ⟹ –2 = 3x² – 6x ⟹ 3x² – 6x + 2 = 0. Using quadratic formula: x = [6 ± √(36–24)]/6 = [6 ± √12]/6 = 1 ± √3/3 = 1 ± 1/√3.

questions.text: एक महिला ने अपनी दोस्त से ₹ 10,00,000 उधार लिए और अगले महीने से मासिक किस्तों में उधार लिया हुआ पैसा वापस करने का वादा किया। एक महीने पश्चात, उसने ₹ 10,000 वापस किए, अगले महीने उसने ₹ 15,000 वापस किए, तीसरे महीने में उसने ₹ 20,000 वापस किए और इसी तरह प्रत्येक महीने की किस्त में समान रूप से वृद्धि करते हुए वापस करती रही।
questions.text_english: A woman borrowed ₹10,00,000 from her friend and promised to return the borrowed money in monthly instalments beginning from the next month. After one month, she returned ₹10,000, the next month she returned ₹15,000, the third month she returned ₹20,000 and so on, thereby increasing the monthly instalment uniformly.

sub_questions.text: दसवें महीने में भुगतान की गई किस्त की राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the amount of instalment paid in the tenth month.
sub_questions.solution: This is an arithmetic progression with first term a = ₹10,000 and common difference d = ₹5,000. The nth term is given by aₙ = a + (n–1)d. For the 10th month: a₁₀ = 10000 + (10–1) × 5000 = 10000 + 45000 = ₹55,000.

sub_questions.text: कौन-सी किस्त में उसने ₹ 40,000 का भुगतान किया था ?
sub_questions.text_english: In which instalment did she pay ₹40,000 ?

sub_questions.text:

अथवा
(ख) कितनी किस्तों तक, वह कुल ₹ 3,25,000 की राशि का भुगतान कर चुकी थी ?

(a) If she returned ₹11,50,000 in all, how many instalments did she pay ?
OR

questions.text: एक मैदान आयताकार है। इस आयताकार मैदान ABCD के चारों कोनों के निर्देशांक A(10, 10), B(40, 10), C(40, 50) और D(x, y) हैं। दो दोस्त अनिल और अनिता ने एक दौड़ लगाने का फैसला किया। अनिता ने बिन्दु A से दौड़ना शुरू किया और वह बिन्दु E की ओर, विकर्ण AC की दिशा में, चल पड़ी, जहाँ E, ABCD के दोनों विकर्णों का प्रतिच्छेद बिन्दु है। बिन्दु E पर पहुँचकर, वह बिन्दु B की ओर, विकर्ण DB की दिशा में जाती है और बिन्दु B पर पहुँचने पर वह BA की दिशा में जाकर बिन्दु A पर वापस आती है। अनिल बिन्दु C से आरम्भ करके, D से होते हुए बिन्दु A तक दौड़ लगाता है।
questions.text_english: A field is in the form of a rectangle. The coordinates of the rectangular field ABCD are A(10, 10), B(40, 10), C(40, 50) and D(x, y). Anil and Anita, two friends decided to have a race. Anita started from point A and moved to point E along the diagonal AC, where E is the point of intersection of both the diagonals of ABCD. From point E, she moved to point B along the other diagonal DB and then moved back to point A along BA. While Anil started from point C and ran to point A via D along the boundary of the field.

sub_questions.text: बिन्दु E के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of point E.
sub_questions.solution: E is the intersection of diagonals of rectangle ABCD. In a rectangle, the diagonals bisect each other, so E is the midpoint of AC. E = midpoint of A(10,10) and C(40,50) = ((10+40)/2, (10+50)/2) = (25, 30).

sub_questions.text: बिन्दुओं B और C के बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance between the points B and C.

sub_questions.text:
(क) बिन्दु D के निर्देशांक और दूरी BD ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) अनिता द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) Find the coordinates of point D and the distance BD.
OR
(b) Find the total distance travelled by Anita.

key_points: (b) Total distance = AE + EB + BA = half AC + half BD + AB = 25 + 25 + 30 = 80... compute correctly

sub_questions.solution:
Part (a): ABCD is a rectangle with A(10,10), B(40,10), C(40,50). In a rectangle, D is such that AD is parallel to BC and AB is parallel to DC. Since A is at (10,10) and B is at (40,10), AB is horizontal with length 30. Since BC is vertical with length 40, DC must also be vertical. D = (10, 50). BD = √[(40–10)² + (10–50)²] = √[900+1600] = √2500 = 50 units.

Part (b): E is the midpoint of AC and BD (diagonals bisect each other in a rectangle). AC = √[(40–10)²+(50–10)²] = √[900+1600] = 50 units. So AE = 25 units, EB = BD/2 = 25 units. AB = √[(40–10)²+(10–10)²] = 30 units. Total distance by Anita = AE + EB + BA = 25 + 25 + 30 = 80 units.

questions.text: पतंग उत्सव भारत में एक लोकप्रिय त्योहार है जो मकर संक्रांति के दौरान मनाया जाता है। यह त्योहार लोगों द्वारा अपनी छतों से पतंग उड़ाकर मनाया जाता है। रीना और रवि भी त्योहार का आनंद लेने के लिए पतंग उड़ा रहे हैं। रीना की पतंग की ऊँचाई धरती से 60 m ऊपर है। पतंग से जुड़ी डोर अस्थायी रूप से धरती पर एक बिन्दु से बँधी होती है, और धरती के साथ डोर का झुकाव 30° है। रवि 10 m ऊँची इमारत से पतंग उड़ा रहा है। उसकी पतंग भी धरती से 60 m ऊपर उड़ रही है और रवि द्वारा इस्तेमाल की गई डोर की लम्बाई रीना की डोर के समान है। θ, छत के एक बिन्दु से रवि की पतंग का उन्नयन कोण है।
questions.text_english: Kite festival is a popular festival in India which takes place during Makar Sankranti. The festival is celebrated by people flying kites from their rooftops. Reena and Ravi are also flying kites to enjoy the festival. The height of Reena's kite is 60 m above the ground. The string attached to the kite is temporarily tied to a point on the ground, and the inclination of the string with the ground is 30°. Ravi is flying a kite from a 10 m high building. His kite is also flying 60 m above the ground and the length of the string used by Ravi is same as that of Reena's. θ is the angle of elevation of Ravi's kite from a point on the rooftop.

sub_questions.text: रीना द्वारा इस्तेमाल करने वाली डोर की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of string used by Reena.
sub_questions.solution: For Reena's kite: height = 60 m, inclination = 30°. sin 30° = height/string length ⟹ 1/2 = 60/L ⟹ L = 120 m. The length of string used by Reena is 120 m.

sub_questions.text: sin θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value of sin θ.
sub_questions.solution: Ravi is on a 10 m building, kite is at 60 m above the ground. Height of kite above rooftop = 60 – 10 = 50 m. Length of string = 120 m (same as Reena's). sin θ = opposite/hypotenuse = 50/120 = 5/12.

sub_questions.text:
(क) यदि डोर की लम्बाई में किसी परिवर्तन के बिना, θ को 60° में बदला जाता है, तो धरती से रवि की पतंग की ऊँचाई क्या होगी ? (√3 = 1·7 प्रयोग कीजिए)
अथवा
(ख) यदि डोरी का झुकाव धरती के साथ 30° है, तो रवि की पतंग की धरती से ऊँचाई कितनी होगी, यह मानते हुए कि डोरी की लम्बाई नहीं बदलती है ?
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) If θ changes to 60°, without changing the length of the string, what will be the height of Ravi's kite above the ground ? (Use √3 = 1·7)
OR
(b) What would have been the height of Ravi's kite above the ground, if the string had an inclination of 30° with the ground, assuming that the length of the string does not change ?
sub_questions.solution:
Part (a): If θ = 60°, string length = 120 m. Height of kite above rooftop = 120 × sin 60° = 120 × (√3/2) = 60√3 = 60 × 1.7 = 102 m. Height above ground = 10 + 102 = 112 m.

Part (b): If string inclination with ground is 30° and string length = 120 m (Ravi's string from the rooftop). Height above rooftop = 120 × sin 30° = 120 × 1/2 = 60 m. Height above ground = 10 + 60 = 70 m.
